long_biography.plain_text:
Utility engineering supplied the operating base for Mészáros's expansion. Mészáros és Mészáros grew around gas networks, water infrastructure, treatment plants, bridges and environmental works, turning a local trade into a substantial construction platform. This technical breadth made civil engineering the foundation of the fortune before his investment portfolio took shape.

His role changed as the portfolio widened. He acquired a large stake in OPUS Global and used the listed holding to combine energy, industrial, food and tourism businesses. Mészáros remains a major OPUS shareholder, but professional managers run day-to-day operations across the wider group. At this scale, his work centres on ownership and strategic oversight, supported by separate holding and fund-management structures.
